_about: Provider types checked by hand. Covers every NHS trust with 10,000+ people waiting (August 2026), plus mental health and community trusts the name patterns in kitchen/sources/ods.py miss (checked against the NHS Staff Survey 2025 benchmarking groups). These always override the patterns. Midlands Partnership runs community and mental health services; its RTT waits are community services. Alder Hey, Birmingham Women's and Children's and Sheffield Children's are benchmarked as acute in the Staff Survey but are specialist children's trusts.
